name: Turning Away From God
overview: Scripture reveals that turning away from God involves choosing paths that seem right to us but lead to death, as seen in Proverbs 14:12. Isaiah 53:6 and 59:2 show how humanity's rebellion and sin separate us from God, hiding His face and preventing His hearing. God's desire is for the wicked to repent and live, urging a return from evil ways in Ezekiel 33:11. Yet, even among Jesus' followers, some do not believe, illustrating the reality of turning away from Him as noted in John 6:64. Joshua 23:12 warns against returning to ungodly alliances that draw believers away from covenant faithfulness.
